description: Reviews one exact npm package version and decides whether to adopt it, combining deps.dev, OSV.dev, npm, DeepWiki and Hacker News: known advisories in the package and its whole dependency tree (with severity and fixes), licenses, deprecation, build provenance and project health. An LLM gives a verdict, then fixed rules decide the route. Returns aiVerdict (ADOPT, ADOPT_WITH_CONDITIONS or AVOID), route (AUTO_APPROVE, AUTO_REJECT or HUMAN_REVIEW) with routeReasons and rejectReasons, recommendedVersion, vulnerableDependencies, missingSources, and a markdown brief (briefMarkdown). Read-only. Takes 30–90 seconds, mostly the LLM's reasoning, and costs one LLM call. A call over about 60 seconds fails at the gateway with HTTP 504, although the review still completes in Conductor; each retry starts a new review. POST_scan is the fast alternative, with security facts only. Inputs: packageName, packageVersion (an exact version such as 4.17.1, not a range), and optionally allowedLicenses.
